content:
PETREX GMBH is a specialized chemical company based at Wachtendonker Straße 11, D-47906 Kempen, Germany, serving both national and international markets with a strong focus on reliability, technical competence, and customer-oriented solutions. Positioned in one of Europe’s most dynamic industrial regions, PETREX GMBH operates as a flexible and responsive partner to various sectors, including industrial manufacturing, coatings, plastics, automotive, construction, and related chemical-processing industries.

The company’s activities center on the sourcing, development, and distribution of high-quality chemical products and intermediates designed to meet demanding performance, safety, and environmental standards. By working closely with both suppliers and end-users, PETREX GMBH aligns product specifications with real-world application needs, ensuring consistency, traceability, and compliance with European regulations such as REACH and applicable ISO standards.

Beyond pure distribution, PETREX GMBH aims to add value through technical support, application advice, and long-term cooperation. Its team combines market knowledge with chemical expertise to help customers optimize formulations, improve process efficiency, and respond to evolving regulatory and sustainability requirements. This consultative approach helps clients reduce risk, streamline their supply chains, and maintain a competitive edge in technically demanding markets.

Strategically located in Kempen, PETREX GMBH benefits from excellent logistics connections, enabling reliable and timely deliveries throughout Germany and across Europe. With an emphasis on professionalism, transparency, and partnership, the company strives to build lasting relationships with customers and suppliers alike, positioning itself as a dependable link between global chemical producers and specialized users who require consistent quality and technical reliability.
